add.title: Log sweep writes a stray public/public/ folder (wrong path), so seven pages in review shots 404
add.why: Seen 2026-11-03 in the review of chat-settings-per-session: the sweep's files land under public/public/ on michael/dev; the review's screenshots of those pages were 404s.

add.title: item tool: {"content":{"remove":[ids]}} removes nothing and is still appended; apply each id, as List.add does for an array, or refuse it
add.why: 2026-11-06, /live/plan/: a remove of 9 ids answered ok:true and wrote the line, and all 9 cards stayed. bad_list_delta does not check that remove's argument is an id string.

add.title: item tool: refuse a bare key on a Page that names neither a field, a declared verb nor a child, e.g. {"tabs": {"text": ""}}
add.why: voice-app wrote {"tabs":{"text":""}} to /live/ on 2026-11-06 meaning the card whose id is tabs ({"content":{"tabs":…}}). Node has no ext/tabs, so the tool accepted it; the browser read it as a call to Page.tabs() and threw, which failed every merge smoke on /live/. ext/tabs now skips it with a warning (worktree/pd-ref-file); the write itself should be refused, naming the nested form.

add.title: page tools: parse or refuse a content.add item passed as a JSON string
add.why: minion-card-styles called page_add/page_set with the item as a string; page_tools.js wrote it as-is and every replay of /live/demos/page.jsonl threw 'Cannot create property parent on string' in List.adopt (errors/2026-11-10.jsonl, fixed by hand in c7a4dd113). The tool should JSON.parse a string that is an object, or refuse it with a clear message, before the line is written. Owner of page_tools.js: mastermind-page-design (paused).
